detail.longDescription: Citrix Workspace is one of those applications I need, but do not want to adopt. So I put its official Debian package in a disposable rootless Podman container on Fedora. X11, PipeWire, GPU and webcam support go in. Citrix-shaped filesystem clutter stays out. It is a packaging boundary, not a security sandbox, and that distinction matters. https:// blog.hofstede.it/running-citri x-workspace-on-fedora-with-rootless-podman/ # Fedora # Podman # Linux # Citrix # DevOps
